verified_key_information_units.information: The Group reported strong headline financial performance in 2025 with total revenue of EUR 53.2 million (2024: EUR 18.2 million), gross profit of EUR 18.8 million (35% margin, 2024: EUR 5.4 million, 30%), operating profit of EUR 14.7 million (2024: EUR 0.1 million), net profit of EUR 12.0 million (2024: EUR 3.9 million loss), earnings per share of EUR 0.22 (2024: EUR -0.06), and operating cash flow generating EUR 10.8 million (2024: EUR 10.4 million used). Total assets increased to EUR 124,490 thousand (2024: EUR 118,758 thousand), total equity rose to EUR 63,327 thousand (2024: EUR 51,221 thousand), with cash of EUR 5,143 thousand (2024: EUR 4,344 thousand), net asset value per share of EUR 1.12 (2024: EUR 0.89), and debt-to-equity ratio improving to 0.97 (2024: 1.32).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report - Key financials; Key performance indicators table; Consolidated interim statements of comprehensive income and financial position

candidate_sentences.text: Total revenue surged to EUR 53.2 million, a substantial increase from EUR 18.2 million in 2024.
Gross profit rose to EUR 18.8 million from EUR 5.4 million the prior year, reflecting a gross margin expansion from 30% to 35%.
Operating profit increased dramatically to EUR 14.7 million, compared to a negligible EUR 0.1 million in 2024, resulting in an operating margin of 28%.
The Group’s net profit for the full year was EUR 12.0 million, reversing the EUR 3.9 million loss recorded in 2024.
Earnings per share improved to EUR 0.22 from EUR -0.06.

Operational cash flow generation strengthened considerably, with cash generated from operating activities reaching EUR 10.8 million in 2025, compared to cash used of EUR 10.4 million in the previous year.
The Group’s balance sheet position also improved, with total equity increasing to EUR 63.3 million from EUR 51.2 million.
Net assets per share rose to EUR 1.12, and the debt-to-equity ratio decreased from 1.32 to 0.97, indicating a more conservative and stable capital structure.

verified_key_information_units.information: Revenue growth was primarily driven by the handover of completed residential units in the Kalaranna District and Uus-Kindrali developments in Tallinn, as well as the City Villas project in Vilnius, contrasting lower 2024 revenue due to delayed starts in Kalaranna and limited sales elsewhere.
